build_model: build the whole detectron2 model architecture from a config object and return an nn.Module
register_meta_arch: register a custom meta-architecture class with the META_ARCH_REGISTRY for model building
get_registered_meta_arch: get a registered meta-architecture class from META_ARCH_REGISTRY by its name string
log_api_usage: log api usage for a detectron2 meta-architecture module via _log_api_usage
setup_model_device: move a built detectron2 model to the device specified in cfg.MODEL.DEVICE
